Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) shows a curvilinear "scimitar" vein on the right side running parallel to the right heart border, accompanied by right lung hypoplasia and ipsilateral mediastinal deviation to the right. The coronal CT (Figure 1) confirms an abnormal systemic artery arising inferiorly (from the abdominal aorta) supplying the right lower lobe, consistent with Scimitar syndrome.
